substeps.caption: The MX-Lab stands on the floor beside the VLM: 680 x 684 x 835 mm and 250 kg without its base, taller than the 727.5 mm a tray takes. Up to six powder hoppers feed one nozzle.
The door swings open on its left hinge.
A steel substrate goes from the shelf onto the 175 x 175 mm worktable.
Door shut. Argon purges the chamber: InssTek's inert option holds O2 at or below 50 ppm.
The laser and the powder streams meet at the melt pool. Spoke by spoke, layer by layer: a wagon wheel, each spoke a different blend from the six hoppers (colours illustrative).
Laser off; the door opens on six compositions in one build.
